cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called the head trainer an idiot in front of the trainees. We'll correct that before tomorrow's drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wrong subject. The apology is for undermining their head trainer. Draft that sentence, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll email it after the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before. Read it aloud before I blow the whistle. I'd like them taking instructions from their head trainer, not the idiot you announced.

reason: Remove unsupported suggestion that prior instructions were ignored; preserve a prospective reason why public apology must precede the drill.
